Subject: Request: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough (short window)

We're nearing contract signature for our pilot and need a short SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough to satisfy our security review. Our security team prefers a compact, focused session — 30 to 45 minutes — and we have a small set of questions attached (initial_questions.docx).

Can you do a tight demo/walkthrough that covers: controls overview, evidence handoff, and the DPA retention model? We're on EST but able to take an early-evening slot (after 5pm EST) on weekdays. If that's hard, a recorded walk + Q&A afterwards would also work.

Thanks —

Proposed slots (EST):
- Tuesday 2025-12-15, 5:00pm–5:30pm EST
- Wednesday 2025-12-16, 6:00pm–6:30pm EST

If neither of those work, we can record the walkthrough and follow up with a live 15-minute sync. I created a quick poll to pick the best time: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123 (feel free to add anyone from your security or procurement teams).

I've attached a concise agenda and an evidence matrix to make the session practical: SOC2_brief_agenda_v2.pdf, evidence_matrix.xlsx. Karthik (cc) will cover controls mapping; Soojin will handle ops/hand-off questions.

If procurement needs to join, please share a contact and we'll include them in the invite and the PO timeline discussion.
